Place and moment: early morning on a small moored rowing boat beside a lakeshore swimming jetty, clean low sunlight and long soft shadows. She pauses before her morning swim, sitting sideways on the boat's broad bench. To make room for a rolled picnic mat being set beside her, she has drawn one knee toward her chest; this temporary compact posture reveals the upper thigh and side waist already left bare by her secure swimsuit. No garment slips, opens or becomes transparent.
Outfit and category: swimwear — a terracotta swimsuit with two opaque diagonal sail-shaped panels crossing into a narrow central bridge, supported by broad crossed back straps and small oval hip yokes over a fully lined, opaque pelvic panel. The sculpted edges leave a clean side-waist opening and high-cut legs. A tiny leaf charm clips to one strap; a closed three-leaf folding fan lies on the bench beside her.
Pose and composition: a three-quarter view from head to mid-shin, camera level with her face, her chest and face turned toward the camera. Her left knee is raised onto the bench, and the other lower leg goes naturally down past the bottom frame edge. Her own right forearm extends forward from the elbow, and her right hand loosely holds the mooring rope at waist height. Her own left arm bends visibly in front of her torso, with the left hand resting on her raised knee. No arm is behind her head or back. Her expression follows the fixed EXPRESSION below.
